comment audit_log_entries Auth: Audit trail for user actions.
comment flow_state Stores metadata for all OAuth/SSO login flows
comment identities Auth: Stores identities associated to a user.
comment instances Auth: Manages users across multiple sites.
comment mfa_amr_claims auth: stores authenticator method reference claims for multi factor authentication
comment mfa_challenges auth: stores metadata about challenge requests made
comment mfa_factors auth: stores metadata about factors
comment oauth_client_states Stores OAuth states for third-party provider authentication flows where Supabase acts as the OAuth client.
comment refresh_tokens Auth: Store of tokens used to refresh JWT tokens once they expire.
comment saml_providers Auth: Manages SAML Identity Provider connections.
comment saml_relay_states Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.
comment schema_migrations Auth: Manages updates to the auth system.
comment sessions Auth: Stores session data associated to a user.
comment sso_domains Auth: Manages SSO email address domain mapping to an SSO Identity Provider.
comment sso_providers Auth: Manages SSO identity provider information; see saml_providers for SAML.
comment users Auth: Stores user login data within a secure schema.
constraint audit_log_entries.audit_log_entries_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_authorization_url_https CHECK (((authorization_url IS NULL) OR (authorization_url ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_authorization_url_length CHECK (((authorization_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(authorization_url) <= 2048)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_client_id_length CHECK (((char_length(client_id) >= 1) AND (char_length(client_id) <= 512)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_discovery_url_length CHECK (((discovery_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(discovery_url) <= 2048)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_identifier_format CHECK ((identifier ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:-]{0,48}[a-z0-9]$'::text))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_identifier_key UNIQUE (identifier)
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_issuer_length CHECK (((issuer IS NULL) OR ((char_length(issuer) >= 1) AND (char_length(issuer) <= 2048))))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_jwks_uri_https CHECK (((jwks_uri IS NULL) OR (jwks_uri ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_jwks_uri_length CHECK (((jwks_uri IS NULL) OR (char_length(jwks_uri) <= 2048)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_name_length CHECK (((char_length(name) >= 1) AND (char_length(name) <= 100)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_oauth2_requires_endpoints CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oauth2'::text) OR ((authorization_url IS NOT NULL) AND (token_url IS NOT NULL) AND (userinfo_url IS NOT NULL))))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_oidc_discovery_url_https CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (discovery_url IS NULL) OR (discovery_url ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_oidc_issuer_https CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (issuer IS NULL) OR (issuer ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_oidc_requires_issuer CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oidc'::text) OR (issuer IS NOT NULL)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_provider_type_check CHECK ((provider_type = ANY (ARRAY['oauth2'::text, 'oidc'::text])))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_token_url_https CHECK (((token_url IS NULL) OR (token_url ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_token_url_length CHECK (((token_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(token_url) <= 2048)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_userinfo_url_https CHECK (((userinfo_url IS NULL) OR (userinfo_url ~~ 'https://%'::text)))
constraint custom_oauth_providers.custom_oauth_providers_userinfo_url_length CHECK (((userinfo_url IS NULL) OR (char_length(userinfo_url) <= 2048)))
